q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of welding electrodes per kg?
title: Welding electrode carbon footprint per kg
short: Add the steel core wire and flux materials per kg of electrodes with supplier figures, then wire drawing, extrusion and baking energy. Divide the plant's energy by kg of electrodes packed.

ul: Flux: minerals, ferro alloys and binders.

p: Report per kg by electrode type and size.

example.title: Worked example: welding electrode unit per kg (one month)
lines: Plant total: 21,300 / 100,000 = 0.213 kg CO2 per kg
Add core wire and flux for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
